verdict.rationale: Bugbot supports on-demand triggering via PR comments (`cursor review`/`bugbot run`) and automatic review on every PR update, plus org-wide rules via Bugbot Automations and BUGBOT.md guidelines. However, there's no evidence of draft-PR skipping, branch/label filtering, or granular per-repo/per-branch control settings that let developers scope exactly when the bot runs. missing for 10: draft-PR skip behavior, branch/label-based filtering rules, explicit settings UI for scoping trigger conditions beyond org-wide automations.
